feature_scope: Lexical counts in the four frozen generated helpers, excluding comments/string literals. Only arguments of setX calls on locally declared PreparedStatement names. Not a semantic analyzer or general Java parser.
target: At least one observed response, SQL outcome or complete nine-table state difference in the archived ordinary/extreme-clock helper protocol; y=0 means no difference found in that protocol only.
sampling: Retrospective diagnostic cases selected around a known defect. No population risk interpretation.
model: Ridge logistic regression; fixed training-only smoothed-prior intercept; training-only centered numeric counts; no scaling, interactions or manual coefficient directions; reuse shared_risk numerical primitives.
weights: Each training region has total weight one; each candidate within it equal weight. GC/BC and clock cases do not create extra candidates.
baseline: Training-only Beta(1,1)-smoothed weighted prior, with the identical candidate weights.
primary_evaluation: Source-held-out evaluation unavailable: all four candidates are tpcc-app. Do not relax the inventory source split or claim external validation.
secondary_evaluation: Explicit retrospective development diagnostic only: hold out NewOrder, then Payment; keep historical/fixed variants together. Same defect repair is shared across regions and is a contamination limitation.
metrics: training-constant features and unseen test values
stop: Exactly two fits with these features/settings. No parameter or feature search after seeing results; no new DB executions, performance measurements or deletion decisions. Do not promote a final model.
limitations: Features and sample choice follow known defect evidence; four candidates, two regions, one project, one repair mechanism. Scores are uncalibrated development outputs, not safe-deletion probabilities. Binding text conversion can be necessary (e.g. JSON); learned association is not a deletion rule. No generic DAG features are extracted in this pilot.
